name: Open Source Configurable Warehouse Management System

mentions.name: Open Source Configurable Warehouse Management System
mentions.description: This is an open source warehouse management system (WMS) that is customisable and configurable. Its codebase is designed to be easy for LLMs to work with so users can download and tailor it to their business/operational requirements, while it ships with out-of-the-box 'industry best practice processes' so users only need to write the 10% of custom logic that differentiates their business. Its flexible processes also enable proper continuous improvement with staff, something the author says traditional WMS products struggle with.
mentions.problem: Traditional WMS products lack flexibility for continuous improvement with staff, forcing businesses to reinvent the wheel instead of focusing on their differentiating custom needs.
mentions.audience: Businesses wanting warehouse management tailored to their operational requirements
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on an open source and customisable/configurable warehouse management system.
